affected_profile: DATA-01 source inventory eligibility counter; no model profile
expected_invariant: A mapped source contributes zero eligible language cues until human-reviewed alignment and reference, approved reference rights, and a reviewed source state are present.

related_controls.condition: Approved reference rights without human source and reference review count zero.
Human alignment without reviewed reference and reference rights counts zero.
Review fields and rights cannot increase the count while source state remains source_checked.
An inspected candidate with approved subtitle and audio rights counts zero.

negative_controls.condition: A reference_reviewed fixture with both human reviews and approved rights counts its sole non-excluded cue.
A fully reviewed development source retains the same one-cue denominator.
